purpose: A consistently formatted numeric table value using Intl.NumberFormat.
behaviorProvider: Shared data-grid cell adapter; table/record state remains with its host.

component: Format finite values using Intl.NumberFormat with the supplied locale/options and default locale en-GB. Render an em dash for non-finite values.
Forward span properties and keep numeric alignment in its own cell styling.
host: Supply valid Intl locale/options and contextual units or column labels.
Own calculations, rounding policy and precision-sensitive values before converting to number.
